description: Defines a custom exception class 'AppException' and an asynchronous FastAPI exception handler function 'app_exception_handler' that returns JSON error responses.

classes.name: AppException
classes.description: Custom exception class for application-specific errors, including a message and an HTTP status code.

methods.name: JSONResponse app_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: AppException)
methods.description: FastAPI exception handler that captures 'AppException' instances and returns a JSON-formatted error response.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, message: str, *, status_code: int = 400) -> None:$/

ctags.name: app_exception_handler
ctags.pattern: /^async def app_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: AppException) -> JSONResponse:$/
